1CH 6:1.KJV: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH 6:5.KJV: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
1CH 6:5.BHSA: וַאֲבִישׁ֨וּעַ֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־בֻּקִּ֔י וּבֻקִּ֖י הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־עֻזִּֽי׃

1CH 6:6.KJV: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

1CH 6:7.KJV: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
1CH 6:7.BHSA: מְרָיֹות֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־אֲמַרְיָ֔ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־אֲחִיטֽוּב׃

1CH 6:8.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

1CH 6:9.KJV: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
1CH 6:9.BHSA: וַאֲחִימַ֨עַץ֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־יֹוחָנָֽן׃

1CH 6:10.KJV: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
1CH 6:10.BHSA: וְיֹוחָנָ֖ן הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָ֑ה ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּהֵ֔ן בַּבַּ֕יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

1CH 6:11.KJV: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
1CH 6:11.BHSA: וַיֹּ֥ולֶד עֲזַרְיָ֖ה אֶת־אֲמַרְיָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־אֲחִיטֽוּב׃

1CH 6:12.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

1CH 6:61.BHSA: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנֹּותָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמַּטֶּ֡ה מִֽ֠מַּחֲצִית מַטֵּ֨ה חֲצִ֧י מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגֹּורָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ ס

1CH 6:62.KJV: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
1CH 6:62.BHSA: וְלִבְנֵ֨י גֵרְשֹׁ֜ום לְמִשְׁפְּחֹותָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִ֠שָׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה אָשֵׁ֜ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה מְנַשֶּׁה֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ ס

1CH 6:63.KJV: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
1CH 6:63.BHSA: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹותָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְ֠אוּבֵן וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־גָ֞ד וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה זְבוּלֻן֙ בַּגֹּורָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

1CH 6:64.KJV: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

1CH 6:65.KJV: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
1CH 6:65.BHSA: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בַגֹּורָ֗ל מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעֹ֔ון וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֵ֚ת הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶתְהֶ֖ם בְּשֵׁמֹֽות׃ ס

1CH 6:66.KJV: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
1CH 6:66.BHSA: וּמִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ות בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גְבוּלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

1CH 6:67.KJV: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
1CH 6:67.BHSA: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־עָרֵ֧י הַמִּקְלָ֛ט אֶת־שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:68.KJV: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,

1CH 6:69.KJV: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:

1CH 6:70.KJV: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
1CH 6:70.BHSA: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־עָנֵר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בִּלְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ לְמִשְׁפַּ֥חַת לִבְנֵי־קְהָ֖ת הַנֹּותָרִֽים׃ פ

1CH 6:71.KJV: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
1CH 6:71.BHSA: לִבְנֵי֮ גֵּרְשֹׁום֒ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֗חַת חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־גֹּולָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ות וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ ס

1CH 6:72.KJV: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
1CH 6:72.BHSA: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־קֶ֖דֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:73.KJV: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

1CH 6:74.KJV: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
1CH 6:74.BHSA: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־מָשָׁ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַבְדֹּ֖ון וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:75.KJV: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

1CH 6:76.KJV: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
1CH 6:76.BHSA: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י אֶת־קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־חַמֹּ֖ון וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־קִרְיָתַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ ס

1CH 6:77.KJV: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
1CH 6:77.BHSA: לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֮ הַנֹּותָרִים֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶת־רִמֹּונֹ֖ו וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־תָּבֹ֖ור וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:78.KJV: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
1CH 6:78.BHSA: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֣ן יְרֵחֹו֮ לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־בֶּ֥צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:79.KJV: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

1CH 6:80.KJV: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
1CH 6:80.BHSA: וּמִ֨מַּטֵּה־גָ֔ד אֶת־רָאמֹ֥ות בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶֽת־מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

1CH 6:81.KJV: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

records.name: Azariah
